g_outcome_check_parse.trace: 'selected: <key>, <key>, ...' and 'chunk <n>: <key>=<outcome>, ...' are split on ', ' and '='. The held outcome is itself 'held <rule> (<what>), recheck <D Mon>', so every held item splits into two entries; feedback keys are 'feedback:<Message-ID>' and Google Message-IDs routinely contain '=' (and may contain '+', '/', '$', backticks); msg- origins on team items the same; snooze keys carry 20 characters of free ask text, which can hold commas, '=' or ':'. A python split then miscounts keys, finds outcomes for keys that do not exist and none for real ones: statuses come out Failed or, worse, a missing key is matched by a fragment. The body also reaches python through the model's transcription, where an unquoted heredoc expands '$' and backticks.

h_statuses.trace: B's RUN RECORD: 'No-op: nothing was due; ... all sent, held or blocked is Completed; Partial: a step failed or was skipped; Failed: stopped early, a SLOW FILE failure or SLOW BATCH's early exit'. SLOW BATCH 4/: Completed only if every key is completed, overtaken, held or blocked; unfinished from cap, minute 22 or tool error is Partial; any other unfinished is Failed; RULES LOAD failure Partial whatever the items show; eligible 0 No-op. B also says 'LOCK, RUN RECORD and HARD RULES here always hold' over the file, so B wins a conflict: a minute 22 or cap stop is 'stopped early' (Failed) under B and Partial under 4/; a RULES LOAD failure with every item blocked is Completed under B and Partial under 4/ and RULES LOAD; 'overtaken' is not in B's Completed list (D2). SLOW FILE failure: B ends Failed 'slow work file unavailable' or 'slow file not loaded: <read> of <total>' and releases; no 'selected:' line, so carryover passes over it: consistent. RULES LOAD failure: Partial 'rules not loaded: <page> <read> of <total>' and nothing written for the actions it governs: consistent between RULES LOAD and 4/.
h_statuses.verdict: fix B's RUN RECORD to defer to 4/ (D2).
